prompt: Create a new Gotify application called 'HomeAutomation' with description 'Smart home events' and default priority 3, then send a test notification through it.

assertions.name: Calls send action
assertions.description: Calls gotify(action='send', message=...) for the test notification

assertions.name: Token model awareness
assertions.description: Either notes that send uses app token not client token, or correctly uses/describes the send action without confusion
